snippet.title: Pibcremental - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy a first look of the demo of our upcoming project Pibcremental!🎉🥚 

It's a cozy idle-incremental clicker game, where you need to rebuild civilization as tiny critters called Pibbles. Assign Pibbles to do various tasks, play mini-games and get clicking yourself to push production to it's limits and regrow your tree.

The demo is out right now! So be sure to give it a try and wishlist 🌱: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4780080/Pibcremental_Demo/
